top_signals.title: NYC Marathon Winner Andreas Almgren on Debut Victory
top_signals.summary: Following his debut victory in the New York City Marathon, Men's Winner Andreas Almgren sat down with Bloomberg's Randall Williams to discuss his victory, the mindset behind winning the marathon, and his path forward. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Feeling isolated? Half of in-office workers describe their jobs as 'remote,' NY Fed survey finds
top_signals.summary: Employees describing jobs as 'remote' are now often in-office, as companies fail to create the collaboration they claim is critical, NY Fed research shows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Oracle Seeks $20 Billion for AI Growth as Meta Weighs New Debt
top_signals.summary: For almost three months, Big Tech companies didn’t borrow in the US bond market. Now they’re flooding in again.
